title: Experimental scoped Package Revision and Runtime Plan references
description: Consumer-side reference envelope only; it is intentionally separate from portable Package Revision content and is not an approved production API schema.

revisionDigest.description: The PackageRevisionId called revision_id in the #129 domain draft; the complete immutable package revision identity, not a source artifact or Runtime Plan digest.

packageRevisionRef.description: The sole owning Package Revision reference in this envelope; a duplicate outer packageRevisionRef is forbidden.

planSchemaVersion.description: Positive PlanSchemaVersion from the #129 header contract. Registry support must be checked by a future consumer.
